audit_statement: The file is the exact nist_ctc_01_asme1_ap242-e1.stp entry from NIST-PMI-STEP-Files.zip. Its Part 21 header declares AP242 edition 1. NIST states that the bundle files were generated by different CAD software, while intentionally removing the individual CAD-system identity; no exporter name or version is inferred from the payload.
export_settings: NIST CTC-01 geometry with PMI representation and/or presentation, serialized as STEP AP242 edition 1; individual CAD application and option details were intentionally removed by NIST.

exporter.name: Undisclosed CAD system in NIST MBE PMI corpus

owner: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
